name: stac-smoke
purpose: Bridge smoke: the served policy plays StacSettlers games (STAC's own Simulation harness, patched pin) as one seat against 3 copies of STAC's POMCP-TS-CR agent and, separately, 3 STAC-bundled JSettlers 1.1.16 robots. Measures bridge errors, fallbacks, MCTS cap hits and decision latency; not a strength claim.

pomcp_ts_cr.source: Dobre & Lascarides, POMCP with Human Preferences in Settlers of Catan (AIIDE 2018), POMCP-TS-CR; paper setting 10k iterations, 4 threads, C=4 with PUCT, offers limit 3

jsettlers.source: STAC-bundled JSettlers 1.1.16 robot (SOCDefaultRobotFactory, server default parameters: FAST strategy)

limitations: Player trading is off in both directions (bank and port trades stay), so neither side's negotiation is measured. STAC's MCTS agents use 4-thread tree parallelism and their own internal RNG, so their play is not reproducible even with a seed; seeding pins the environment (board, deck, first player, seats, dice by roll index, steals, forced discards, JSettlers robot tie-breaks). Seats come from the seeded shuffle, not a rotation. The MCTS time cap (10 s per search) is a deviation from the paper's uncapped 10k iterations and is counted per search.
